newsitem.title: USA: FBI arrests Rwandan genocide suspect in Texas.
newsitem.headline: FBI arrests Rwandan genocide suspect in Texas.

text.p: A man wanted in Rwanda for genocide has been arrested by FBI agents in Texas and is to be charged by a magistrate there on Friday, the FBI said.

Agent Mike Appleby in San Antonio said Elsaphane Ntakirutimana, 73, was arrested without incident in Cotulla, Texas, near Laredo, on Friday on the basis of a provisional warrant issued by a U.S. magistrate in Laredo.
He said Ntakirutimana had been charged by the U.N. International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda with genocide, complicity in genocide, conspiracy to commit genocide and crimes against humanity.
At the magistrate's hearing, Ntakirutimana will be read the charges against him, Appleby said, adding it was likely that extradition would be sought.
